reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are what get me, plus $24.99 launch price and the money-back guarantee mean one box is a small risk. I would not buy the second box until I see if I sleep better.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? At $29.99 after the launch deal I would just wait for a coupon on something else.
would_change_my_mind: If the regular price stayed at $29.99 with no coupons or bundle deals, I would pass after the launch box.
